about: Provenance for docs/contract.json. VCF Automation (the VMware Cloud Foundation 9.1 successor to vRealize Automation / Aria Automation) publishes no machine-readable API specification: it is absent from the vmware/vcf-api-specs repository (Apache-2.0), which carries specifications for SDDC Manager, VCF Installer, VCF Operations and friends but not for Automation. Vendor paths, fields, types, requirement flags and documented status codes were transcribed by hand from the human-readable xAPIs reference pages listed below. Local retry, idempotency and wire-discipline commitments that the pages do not state are explicitly labeled as inferred in docs/contract.json.
primary_reference_set: VCF Automation API | VM Apps Org - Policies

sources.documents: (index) Broadcom Developer Portal xAPIs catalogue; used to locate the VCF Automation reference sets and confirm no OpenAPI artefact is published for them.
(index) Operation index for the VM Apps Org - Policies reference set; establishes the complete set of /policy/api operations and their canonical paths.

Create Policy. Source of the summary 'Creates a new policy, updates an existing policy, or trigger a policy dry-run.', the dryRun and validationOnly query parameters, the Policy request-body schema (typeId required; id optional, uuid), and the statement that the 200/201/202 responses return no data structure.
Get Policy. Source of the summary 'Returns a specified policy', the id path parameter, the computeStats query parameter, the Policy response schema field list, and the 200/401/403/404 status codes.

Get Policy Type By Id. Source of the id path parameter, the absence of query parameters, the PolicyType response schema (id, name, displayName, config, definitionSchema, targetSchema) and the 200/400/401/403/404 status codes.

(index) Operation index for the All Apps Org - Instances reference set; cross-check that /policy/api/policies and /policy/api/policyTypes/{id} are spelled identically in the All Apps org flavour of VCF Automation.

Create Policy (All Apps Org flavour). Cross-check for the Create Policy request body; source of the per-field descriptions and maximum lengths recorded in the contract (name max 1024, description max 2000, enforcementType SOFT|HARD defaulting to HARD) and of the read-only server-managed fields.
Get Policy (All Apps Org flavour). Cross-check for the Policy response schema and for typeId being the only required field.

Get Policy Type By Id (All Apps Org flavour). Cross-check for the PolicyType response schema; source of the documented config keys (enableDryRun, enableEnforcementType, enableOpaRegoCriteria, enablePolicyValidation, enableReconciliation, enableSingleProjectScope, enableUpdateNotification, maxNumberOfPoliciesPerOrg, maxNumberOfPoliciesPerProject) used for the loopback fixture.

supplementary_sources.documents: Product documentation, not an API reference page. Used only for realistic fixture values: the worked 'Create a Lease Policy' example showing typeId 'com.vmware.policy.deployment.lease' and a definition of leaseGrace / leaseTermMax / leaseTotalTermMax posted to /policy/api/policies.
